answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, held in escrow until finality, no identity may audit its own recruit. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Reaching the ridge of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The jetty holds work receipts rather than names, so the sparrow of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
